name: card-flip
title: Card Flip
description: A card that turns over on a spring to show its back, on click, Enter or Space, or optionally while a mouse hovers it.

props.name: front
props.description: Content of the front face. Keep it non-interactive: the card is the button.

props.name: trigger
props.description: hover also flips while a mouse is over the card. Click and keyboard always flip.

props.name: flipped
props.description: Controlled state; true shows the back.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the card. Set its size here.
